description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Duty on Beverages, w.e.f. 13.10.2020
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, amending excise duty rates on specific goods. It involves regulatory changes to fiscal policy through statutory instruments, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions Mahinda Rajapaksa as Minister of Finance, it does not constitute a personnel appointment or government restructuring, and the detailed content focuses exclusively on regulatory amendments rather than portfolio responsibilities or organizational changes.
